D: A sixteen-year-old with a quick wit finds herself pregnant and picks the perfect couple to adopt the baby.
P: Serve the drink when Juno is sitting on the front lawn with her big jug of orange juice.
S: Almonds and cashews candied with orange zest and cinnamon

Almonds and cashews tossed in a bubbling orange zest and sugar syrup, roasted until glassy and crunchy, finished with flaky salt. Heat 80g caster sugar, 2 tbsp water and the finely grated zest of an orange until the sugar dissolves and bubbles. Take off the heat and stir in 200g almonds, 200g cashews and a pinch of cinnamon until coated. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until glassy. Sprinkle with sea salt flakes, cool completely and break apart.
Beef sliders with cheddar, pickles and tomato sauce on small buns
Mini beef patties with cheddar, pickles and tomato sauce on small sesame buns, held together with a toothpick.
Gold shorts peanut butter oat bites
Bleeker running in his gold track shorts

Rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, dark chocolate chips and coconut mixed and rolled into balls, chilled firm and dusted in golden toasted coconut. Toast 40g desiccated coconut in a dry pan until golden and set aside. Mix 150g rolled oats, 120g smooth peanut butter, 80g honey, 60g dark chocolate chips, 2 tbsp chia seeds, half a tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt until it holds together. Roll into 16 balls, then roll each in the toasted coconut. Chill for an hour until firm.
M: Beef, mushroom, corn and green bean casserole under crisp potato gems
Beef mince browned with onion, mixed with corn, green beans and a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with rows of potato gems and baked at 200C for 35 minutes.
Mac's creamy chicken wild rice soup
Juno's dad Mac at the kitchen table

Chicken, wild rice, carrot, celery and mushroom simmered in stock, finished with cream and thyme, served with crusty bread and butter. Rinse 150g wild rice blend. Soften a diced onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 200g sliced mushrooms in 40g butter. Stir in 3 tbsp flour, then 1.5L chicken stock, the rice and thyme. Add 600g chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until the rice is tender. Lift out the chicken, shred and return it. Stir in 200ml cream and heat through. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Blue jelly with raspberries, vanilla custard and whipped cream

Bright blue jelly set in clear cups with fresh raspberries, layered with vanilla custard, whipped cream and crushed shortbread on top. Make up 2 packets of blue jelly following the packet directions. Drop a few raspberries from 125g into 4 clear cups, pour in the jelly and chill for 3 hours until set. Spoon 300ml thick vanilla custard over the jelly. Whip 200ml cream to soft peaks and spoon on top. Finish with crushed shortbread and the rest of the raspberries just before serving.
K: Fresh orange juice and mango nectar with soda water over ice
Fresh orange juice in a big jug over ice, with a splash of mango nectar and soda water for fizz.

m.note: Beef, mushroom, corn and green bean casserole under crisp potato gems

d.note: Fresh orange juice and mango nectar with soda water over ice
d.how: Juice 8 oranges into a big jug over plenty of ice. Stir in 250ml mango nectar, then top up with 500ml cold soda water just before serving so it keeps some fizz. Add a few orange slices to the jug and pour into tall glasses.
